# Revolve — Template Tasks & Research Notes

## Overview

- **Source**: ColorLib Carousel 01 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-01/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bootstrap/carousel-01/`
- **Assigned Name**: `revolve`
- **Category**: Travel / Full-Screen Carousel

## Structure Order

1. **Full-Screen Carousel Hero**:
   - High-impact background slides (Japan, Singapore, Norway)
   - Subtitle: "BEST PLACE TO TRAVEL"
   - Main Title: Destination name in large bold uppercase text
   - Action buttons / Explore links
2. **Navigation Controls**:
   - Prev/Next arrow buttons
   - Pagination dots at the bottom center
3. **Footer**:
   - Copyright and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`)

## Fidelity & Design Notes

- Typography: `Poppins` font family with bold uppercase headings.
- Overlay: Dark semi-transparent gradient over high-resolution destination photography to ensure crisp text legibility.
- Animations: Smooth slide transitions with active dot state highlighting.
